# shopify_page (List Resource)

Lists all pages of the store, `contact` included. Generated config carries the body, so page texts end up in the configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated config carries each page's body.
list "shopify_page" "all" {
  provider = shopify
}
```
